name: Uncle Mimi's Kitchen
tagline: Artisan baked goods made fresh on Martha's Vineyard.
metaDescription: Uncle Mimi's Kitchen is a small-batch artisan bakery on Martha's Vineyard. Blue-ribbon focaccia, braided challah, granola, scones and cakes — made fresh and local. Find us at the Chilmark, Katama, and North Tisbury stores.
